verificationMethod: Verified against official primary URLs, arXiv/DOI records, GitHub repository snapshots (2026-11-21), and live search checks (2026-11-23).

sources.title: Delving into LLM-assisted writing in biomedical publications through excess vocabulary (Science Advances 2025)
sources.keyFact: Analyzed 15M PubMed abstracts and estimated at least 13.5% of 2024 biomedical abstracts were processed with LLMs (lower bound), marked by excess words like 'delve', 'intricate', and 'pivotal'.

sources.title: Most biomedical publications show signs of LLM-assisted writing (Holzwarth, González-Márquez & Kobak, 2026)
sources.keyFact: Expanded excess-vocabulary tracking across PubMed Central open-access papers found higher LLM signature prevalence in discursive Discussion sections (~68–78%) than Methods sections (~32–58%).

sources.title: Does Writing with Language Models Reduce Content Diversity? (ICLR 2024)
sources.keyFact: Feedback-tuned models (RLHF) reduce collective lexical and content diversity compared with unaided human writing.

sources.title: Generative artificial intelligence enhances creativity but reduces the diversity of novel content (Science Advances 2024)
sources.keyFact: Controlled short-story experiments showed AI ideas improved individual ratings while making stories across writers significantly more similar to one another.

sources.title: Artificial Hivemind: The Open-Ended Homogeneity of Language Models (and Beyond) (NeurIPS 2025)
sources.keyFact: Using the Infinity-Chat dataset, demonstrated both intra-model repetition and inter-model homogeneity across different LLM families.

sources.title: Verbalized Sampling: How to Mitigate Mode Collapse and Unlock LLM Diversity
sources.keyFact: Prompting models to verbalize a distribution of candidate outputs mitigates RLHF typicality bias without retraining.

sources.title: EQ-Bench Slop Score
sources.keyFact: Public composite index (60% slop words + 25% 'not X but Y' contrast frames + 15% overused trigrams) measuring LLM output templating.

sources.title: Fast-DetectGPT: Efficient Zero-Shot Detection of Machine-Generated Text
sources.keyFact: Probabilistic conditional-probability curvature detector for flagging likely machine-generated text; useful as a statistical reference, not a rewrite guide.

sources.title: Binoculars: Zero-Shot Detection of LLM-Generated Text
sources.keyFact: Compares perplexity and cross-perplexity between two observer models to classify machine-generated passages.

sources.title: Pangram AI Detection
sources.keyFact: Commercial AI-text classifier cited in Substack's creator-reaction discussions; probabilistic scores do not tell writers which phrase or slide defect to edit.

sources.title: Wikipedia: Signs of AI writing (WP:AISIGNS)
sources.keyFact: WikiProject AI Cleanup's living taxonomy of AI prose defects: inflated significance, stock vocabulary, rule-of-three lists, negative parallelisms, chatbot wrappers, and formatting artifacts.

sources.title: Simon Willison: Slop is the new name for unwanted AI-generated content
sources.keyFact: Published 2024-05-08; popularized 'slop' for unsolicited, unreviewed AI-generated content by analogy to email spam.

sources.title: ASD-STE100 Simplified Technical English Specification
sources.keyFact: Aerospace and technical documentation specification enforcing short active sentences, one instruction per sentence, and consistent naming for the same concept.

sources.title: Digital.gov Plain Language Guide (formerly PlainLanguage.gov)
sources.keyFact: Federal plain-writing rules: front-load key conclusions, use active voice, replace hidden verbs and filler openings with concrete actors and actions.

sources.title: GOV.UK Content and Style Guide
sources.keyFact: Bans empty corporate padding and buzzwords ('deliver', 'key', 'going forward') in favor of direct user-facing verbs and verifiable dates/numbers.

sources.title: Google Technical Writing Courses
sources.keyFact: Engineering writing guidance prioritizing short sentences, clear actors, explicit scope boundaries, and lists/tables over wall-of-text paragraphs.

sources.title: The /llms.txt Proposal (llmstxt.org)

sources.title: Google Search Central: Tell Google about localized versions of your page
sources.keyFact: Requires reciprocal return links across all language variants plus x-default pointing to canonical HTML URLs or sitemap xhtml:link blocks.

sources.title: Google Search Central: Intro to structured data markup (JSON-LD)
sources.keyFact: Recommends JSON-LD matching visible page content to disambiguate SoftwareApplication, Article, FAQPage, Organization, and BreadcrumbList entities.

sources.title: OpenAI Crawlers: OAI-SearchBot vs. GPTBot
sources.keyFact: Separates OAI-SearchBot (live ChatGPT search retrieval/citations) from GPTBot (model training) in robots.txt access rules.

sources.title: Perplexity Crawlers Documentation (PerplexityBot)
sources.keyFact: Documents PerplexityBot retrieval behavior; blocking it in robots.txt or CDN rules removes pages from live citation synthesis.
